entries.source: Sector illustrations have lighter arrows, clearer contours and a shorter map key.

drafts.zu: Imidwebo yeSector inemicibisholo ethambile, imigqa yokuphakama ecacile nokhiye wemephu omfushane.
drafts.st: Ditshwantsho tsa Sector di na le metsu e bobebe, mela e hlakileng ya bophahamo le senotlolo se sekgutshwane sa mmapa.
drafts.ts: Swifaniso swa Sector swi na miseve yo vevuka, milayeni ya ku tlakuka leyi vonakaka kahle ni nhlamuselo yo koma ya mepe.
drafts.ve: Zwifanyiso zwa Sector zwi na misevhe i leluwaho, mitalo ya vhulapfu i vhonalaho zwavhuḓi na ṱhalutshedzo pfufhi ya mapa.
